# CodeVetter — full agent brief

Execution-backed verification and evaluation for coding agents. CodeVetter turns an agent change into reproducible runtime evidence and a measurable verdict without uploading the repository to a CodeVetter server.

## Index

# CodeVetter

Execution-backed verification for coding-agent changes.

## What it is

- Reproducible runtime evidence for agent changes
- Deterministic and calibrated graders
- CLI, MCP, and machine-readable verification bundles
- Local SQLite storage and a native macOS viewer
- Open source (ISC)

## Who it's for

Engineers evaluating or shipping coding-agent changes who need executable evidence before accepting a result — without uploading the repository to a CodeVetter server.

## Current availability

- The public release currently contains an Apple-silicon macOS DMG and updater archive.
- The desktop distribution packages local CLI and stdio MCP sidecars.
- No npm package, hosted verifier, hosted MCP server, Homebrew cask, Intel macOS installer, Windows installer, or Linux installer is currently published.
- Provider-backed review sends selected context directly to the provider configured by the user; no CodeVetter review server is required.
